title: Biscuit's First Day as a Waiter
one_line_rule: Tell Biscuit's story and play along: Each beat, read the card, Then tap What happens next?

brief.intent:
Make a "play along" story quiz like a funny reel: "Biscuit's First Day as a Waiter". A golden retriever named Biscuit lands a job at the fanciest restaurant in town, and everything goes hilariously wrong. Tell it in 5 short beats, in order: Biscuit's interview with the snooty head chef, taking a food critic's order, carrying a tower of soup bowls, the birthday cake moment, and the surprise ending.

Each beat: a one or two line story segment on a card, then the story pauses and a question card asks "What happens next?" with 4 answers in a 2 x 2 grid and an 8 second countdown. Then the reveal: the real answer stays lit and a one-line explanation (the punchline) shows before the next beat. Make the real answer the funniest one, but make the wrong answers believable too.

End card: how many you called out of 5. Friends in a Group play the same story so they can compare their picks afterwards. Pastel blue and violet answer tiles (no red, yellow or green), big readable text, cartoon style.
